CustomField.description: When the export produces more than one file, download them together as one zip file with this name instead of as separate files. {date} is replaced with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to download each file separately.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name of a zip file to bundle several files into, e.g. "Account Overview {date}". Leave blank to download each workbook separately.
CustomField.label: Zip File Name
